# The manifest

Everything the hub and a person can know about a plugin before it runs. A `static` in the plugin crate. Rendered by the app, `swifty plugin info` and the generated reference, and checked by the conformance suite.

Write it as `pub static MANIFEST: Manifest = Manifest { .. };` in `src/lib.rs`, and return `&MANIFEST` from `Plugin::manifest`. Conformance check 1 holds it to the rules below. The JSON is what `GET /api/v1/plugins/{plugin}` and `swifty plugin info --json` show.

## `Manifest`

| Field | Type | Meaning | Rule |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `&'static str` | `[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,31}`. Also the default instance id and the prefix of custom action ids. | `[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,31}`. Unique among plugins. Custom action ids start with it. |
| `name` | `&'static str` | The name people see. | Not empty. |
| `version` | `&'static str` | The crate version: `env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION")`. | `env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION")`, so it is always the crate's version. |
| `api` | `u32` | The plugin API it was written for. Must equal `API_VERSION`. | `API_VERSION`. A plugin built for another version is not loaded. |
| `summary` | `&'static str` | One sentence on what it connects to. | Not empty. One sentence. |
| `reach` | `Reach` | Whether it stays on the local network or goes through a vendor's servers. | `Local`, or `Cloud` with `official: false` when the vendor does not document the API for third parties. |
| `network` | `&'static [NetUse]` | Everything it opens a socket to. Shown before setup. Declared, not enforced. | Every port, broadcast and cloud host it opens a socket to. Shown before setup. |
| `classes` | `&'static [DeviceClass]` | The classes of the devices it offers. | At least one. Every device, custom action and noun uses one of these. |
| `config_version` | `u32` | Bumped when the stored config changes shape. See `Plugin::migrate`. | Start at 1. Bump it when the stored config changes shape, and implement `Plugin::migrate`. |
| `config` | `&'static [ConfigField]` | The settings of an instance. | Keys `[a-z][a-z0-9_]*`, each once. A field is required or has a default, not both. A choice's default is one of its options. The typed config must accept every key and refuse an unknown one. |
| `secrets` | `&'static [SecretSlot]` | The credentials an instance stores. | Slots `name` or `name/{key}` in `[a-z0-9_]`, each once, and never also a config key. |
| `actions` | `&'static [CustomAction]` | The actions it adds to the catalog. | Ids `<plugin id>.<verb>`. Never `read` or `safe_direction`. Class one of `classes`. |
| `vocabulary` | `&'static [(&'static str, &'static str)]` | What the recogniser mishears, as words: ("whiz", "wiz"). Words only, never grammar. | Lower-case words. Never a word the voice grammar acts on, and never a word mapped to itself. |
| `nouns` | `&'static [(&'static str, DeviceClass)]` | Brand words that name a class: ("sonos", DeviceClass::Speaker). | Lower-case words, not grammar words, each naming a class of `classes`. |
| `multi_instance` | `bool` | Whether a second instance makes sense (two bridges, two clusters). | True when a second instance makes sense (a second bridge, a second account). |

## `Reach`

Where a plugin's traffic goes.

| Variant | Meaning | JSON |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Local` | Talks only to devices on the local network. | `{"reach":"local"}` |
| `Cloud` | Goes through a vendor's servers. `official` is false when the vendor does not document the API for third parties. The app says so. | `{"reach":"cloud","vendor":"Acme","official":false}` |

The variant is in `reach`.

## `NetUse`

One kind of connection a plugin opens.

| Variant | Meaning | JSON |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Http` | Plain HTTP to a device. | `{"use":"http","port":80}` |
| `Https` | HTTPS to a device. | `{"use":"https","port":443}` |
| `Ws` | A websocket to a device. | `{"use":"ws","port":3000}` |
| `Tcp` | A TCP connection to a device. | `{"use":"tcp","port":6668}` |
| `Udp` | UDP datagrams to a device. | `{"use":"udp","port":38899}` |
| `UdpBroadcast` | UDP broadcasts on the local network. | `{"use":"udp_broadcast","port":38899}` |
| `WakeOnLan` | Wake-on-LAN packets. | `{"use":"wake_on_lan"}` |
| `CloudHost` | HTTPS to a vendor's server. | `{"use":"cloud_host","host":"api.example.org"}` |

The variant is in `use`.

## `ConfigField`

One setting of an instance, as a form field and a line of documentation.

| Field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `key` | `&'static str` | The key in the instance config. |
| `label` | `&'static str` | The field's label. |
| `help` | `&'static str` | One sentence for the person filling it in. |
| `kind` | `FieldKind` | What it may hold. |
| `required` | `bool` | Whether it must be given. |
| `default` | `Option<&'static str>` | The value it has when it is not given, as text. |

The fields describe the config for forms, `swifty plugin info` and these pages. The typed struct in your `src/config.rs` is what really parses it (`serde` with `deny_unknown_fields`, plus your checks), and conformance check 2 proves the two agree: the fixture config validates, a missing required key and an unknown key are refused with the key named, and every declared key parses with a value of its kind. A `default` is text, read the way the field's kind reads.

## `FieldKind`

What a config field may hold.

| Variant | Meaning | JSON |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Text` | Text. | `{"type":"text","max_len":64}` |
| `Host` | IP address or host name. | `{"type":"host"}` |
| `Url` | A URL. | `{"type":"url","schemes":["http","https"]}` |
| `HostPort` | A host and a port. | `{"type":"host_port"}` |
| `Port` | A port. | `{"type":"port"}` |
| `Int` | A whole number in a range. | `{"type":"int","min":1,"max":3600}` |
| `Bool` | `true` or `false`. | `{"type":"bool"}` |
| `Choice` | One of these words. | `{"type":"choice","options":["eu","us"]}` |
| `Mac` | A MAC address. | `{"type":"mac"}` |
| `Rows` | A list of rows, each with these fields (Tuya sockets, Toshiba units, WiZ bulbs). | below |

The variant is in `type`.

`Rows`:

```json
{
  "fields": [
    {
      "default": null,
      "help": "The device's id: lower-case letters, digits, - and _.",
      "key": "id",
      "kind": {
        "max_len": 64,
        "type": "text"
      },
      "label": "Id",
      "required": true
    },
    {
      "default": null,
      "help": "Its IP address, such as 192.0.2.20.",
      "key": "address",
      "kind": {
        "type": "host"
      },
      "label": "Address",
      "required": true
    }
  ],
  "type": "rows"
}
```

## `SecretSlot`

A credential this plugin stores. The value never appears in config.

| Field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `slot` | `&'static str` | "app_key"; for rows: "local_key/{id}". |
| `label` | `&'static str` | The field's label. |
| `help` | `&'static str` | One sentence on where to find it. |
| `required` | `bool` | Whether the instance cannot work without it. |

A slot is `name`, or `name/{key}` for one secret per config row: `local_key/{id}` declares one key per row, stored as `local_key/<that row's id>`. The setup flow returns values in `SetupResult::secrets`; the hub stores them and hands them to `connect` in `LiveContext::secrets`. The pure calls only see which slots hold a value (`InstanceView::secrets_present`). A value never appears in the config.

## `CustomAction`

An action a plugin adds to the catalog, beyond the standard ones.

| Field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `&'static str` | `"<plugin id>.<verb>"`. |
| `label` | `&'static str` | A short name for it. |
| `description` | `&'static str` | What will happen. |
| `consequences` | `&'static [&'static str]` | What follows from it. |
| `class` | `DeviceClass` | The class of device it acts on. |
| `tier` | `Tier` | A request. The hub applies the floor. |
| `params` | `&'static [ParamDef]` | Its parameters. |
| `idempotent` | `bool` | False means a repeat would do the thing twice, so it is never retried. |
| `confirm_timeout_ms` | `u64` | How long the hub waits for the device to show the change. |
| `expect` | `Expect` | How the hub tells it worked. |

The floors the hub applies to `tier` are in [capabilities.md](capabilities.md#custom-actions-and-their-floors). For the device to be a target, its `DeviceDecl::capabilities` must include `Capability::Custom { action }` with this id. The driver receives `Op::Custom { action, args }`, whose `args` passed `params`.

## `Expect`

How the hub confirms a custom action from `State::Custom`. Part of a manifest, so it is `static` data.

| Variant | Meaning | JSON |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Unreadable` | Nothing can show it worked. The run ends "sent", like a key press. | `{"expect":"unreadable"}` |
| `FieldEqualsArg` | `fields[field]` equals the argument named `arg`. | `{"expect":"field_equals_arg","field":"position","arg":"position"}` |
| `FieldIs` | `fields[field]` is this boolean. | `{"expect":"field_is","field":"calibrated","value":true}` |
| `CounterIncreased` | `fields[field]` is an integer greater than before the command. Needs a baseline. | `{"expect":"counter_increased","field":"cycles"}` |

The variant is in `expect`.

Only a `State::Custom` can meet an `Expect`, so a device with a custom action reports `custom` state with the field the rule looks at. `Unreadable` is never met: the run ends `sent`, like a key press. `CounterIncreased` makes the hub read the state before sending.

## `Tier`

How much an action can do, and so what it takes to run it.

| Variant | Code | Meaning | JSON |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Read` | 0 | 0: reads. Needs a session. | `"read"` |
| `Comfort` | 1 | 1: comfort. Needs a session. | `"comfort"` |
| `Consequential` | 2 | 2: consequential. Prepare, then confirm. | `"consequential"` |
| `Critical` | 3 | 3: critical. Prepare, then a passkey assertion bound to the action. | `"critical"` |
| `SafeDirection` | S | "S": moves the system toward safety (the printer emergency stop). Needs a session, and voice can run it when it is named. | `"safe_direction"` |

## `ParamDef`

One parameter of an action.

| Field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `&'static str` | The parameter's name in the action's `params`. |
| `kind` | `ParamKind` | What it may hold. |
| `required` | `bool` | Whether it must be given. |
| `help` | `&'static str` | One sentence for the person filling it in. |

## `ParamKind`

What a parameter may hold.

| Variant | Meaning | JSON |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Bool` | `true` or `false`. | `"bool"` |
| `Int` | A whole number in a range. | `{"int":{"min":0,"max":100}}` |
| `Enum` | One of these words. | `{"enum":["slow","fast"]}` |
| `Label` | A short human label: printable characters only. | `{"label":{"max_len":40}}` |

The variant is the object's one key, or the whole value for `bool`.

A parameter's value reaches the driver in `Op::Custom::args` as a `Scalar`: `bool` as `Bool`, `int` as `Int`, `enum` and `label` as `Text`.

## A custom action, as `plugins/mock` declares it

```json
{
  "id": "mock.set_level",
  "label": "Set a gadget's level",
  "description": "Sets the level of a pretend gadget, a device of a class the hub has no shape for.",
  "consequences": [
    "Nothing real changes: the gadget lives in memory."
  ],
  "class": "other",
  "tier": "comfort",
  "params": [
    {
      "name": "level",
      "kind": {
        "int": {
          "min": 0,
          "max": 10
        }
      },
      "required": true,
      "help": "The level, from 0 to 10."
    }
  ],
  "idempotent": true,
  "confirm_timeout_ms": 3000,
  "expect": {
    "expect": "field_equals_arg",
    "field": "level",
    "arg": "level"
  }
}
```

## A whole manifest: `plugins/plex`

The shortest first-party manifest, as JSON.

```json
{
  "id": "plex",
  "name": "Plex",
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "api": 1,
  "summary": "Whether a Plex Media Server is up and accepts its token. Read-only: nothing is played or changed.",
  "reach": {
    "reach": "local"
  },
  "network": [
    {
      "use": "http",
      "port": 32400
    },
    {
      "use": "https",
      "port": 32400
    }
  ],
  "classes": [
    "service"
  ],
  "config_version": 1,
  "config": [
    {
      "key": "url",
      "label": "Server URL",
      "help": "The server's base URL: scheme, host and port only, such as http://192.0.2.20:32400.",
      "kind": {
        "type": "url",
        "schemes": [
          "http",
          "https"
        ]
      },
      "required": true,
      "default": null
    }
  ],
  "secrets": [
    {
      "slot": "token",
      "label": "Token",
      "help": "The server's X-Plex-Token. Sent only in the X-Plex-Token header, never in a URL.",
      "required": true
    }
  ],
  "actions": [],
  "vocabulary": [],
  "nouns": [
    [
      "plex",
      "service"
    ]
  ],
  "multi_instance": true
}
```
